svg.title: A 250-person firm in eight zones, and the ten flows that are permitted
svg.desc: The internet sits above eight zones. Guest, VLAN 170, may reach the internet on TCP 80 and 443. Users, VLAN 110, reach the internet on TCP 80 and 443 through the proxy, servers on TCP 445, 88, 389, 636, and 3268, print on TCP 9100 and 631, and out-of-band management on TCP 22 and 443 from named admin hosts. Servers, VLAN 100, reach named internet destinations on TCP 443 and the camera range in building systems, VLAN 140, on TCP 554 and 80. The DMZ, VLAN 200, reaches 10.0.0.50 on TCP 5432, and the internet reaches the DMZ on TCP 80 and 443 at 203.0.113.10. Voice, VLAN 120, reaches servers on UDP 5060 and media. Everything else, 62 of 72 directions, is denied.
svg.text: A 250-person firm in eight zones, and the ten flows that are permitted

g.text: outside every zone, reached only on the paths below
Eight zones give 8 x 7 = 56 directed pairs, plus 8 outbound and 8 inbound internet paths: 72 decisions.
Ten are permitted. The other 62 are denied, including users to users and guest to anything internal.
